title: eludite.output.show input
description: Show the Output window (View > Output, Ctrl+Alt+O) with a source selected in its "Show output from" dropdown, and read the end of that source's text: Build is the build log, Host is eludite-host's own log, Language Servers is the log of the language servers the shell runs itself (rust-analyzer: its stderr, window/logMessage and window/showMessage), Debug is the program's output while it runs under the debugger or without it (the debug adapter's output events, or the program's stdout and stderr for Ctrl+F5) with the debugger's own messages, and Browser is the browser of the eludite.browser.* tools: its launch, tabs opened and closed, navigation failures, console errors and its exit, and Tests is the test runners' output: the Test Explorer's discoveries and runs (eludite-host's MTP and VSTest logs, cargo test's output), and Package Manager is what NuGet did: the Manage NuGet Packages window's and eludite.nuget.*'s installs, updates, uninstalls, consolidations and restores (brief 0048).

tail.description: How many of the last lines to return (default 50, at most 2000; 0 for none).
